title: FOLLOW-THROUGH IS WHERE TRUST LIVES.
subtitle: Trust is not built at launch; it is built when institutions keep returning to unfinished work.
speaker: NORA
quote: Trust is not a launch event. It is a return visit.
facts: Water systems need visible last-mile delivery.
Safety disclosure matters for public confidence.
Claims and support must continue beyond the headline.
takeaway: Institutional memory and repeated delivery turn governance into belief.
